title: Toddler in Overalls Raking Yard, 1937 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming Depression-era outdoor snapshot showing a young toddler boy dressed in work overalls and a striped short-sleeved shirt intently pulling a garden rake across a gravel driveway or yard. In the background behind the child, a small fluffy dog rests beneath an orchard or shade tree. The handwritten note on the back indicates it was printed on May 24, 1937.
